plugins.name: copy
plugins.description: Four editing skills for public-facing copy, with one canonical order. honest audits claims against the record, plain finds the jargon a named reader cannot parse, humanize cuts machine tells and enforces a length budget, desk runs a draft through an editorial role chain with an isolated reader panel.
